title: Product Hunt Scraper input
description: Scrape Product Hunt daily/weekly/monthly leaderboards, topic feeds or specific launch URLs. Optional details: website, makers, rating, categories.

mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: leaderboard = launches by date range; topic = launches in topic feeds; urls = specific /posts/ or /products/ URLs.

period.title: Leaderboard period
period.description: Which leaderboard to read for each date in the range: daily (one page per day), weekly (ISO week) or monthly.

featuredOnly.title: Featured launches only
featuredOnly.description: On: Product Hunt's featured leaderboard ranked by daily/weekly/monthly rank. Off: all launches of the period, ranked by votes (the leaderboard's 'All' tab).

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First day to scrape (YYYY-MM-DD) or relative like '7 days'. Defaults to yesterday in Pacific Time (Product Hunt's launch day).

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Last day to scrape (inclusive). Empty = same as start date. Max range 366 days.

topics.title: Topic slugs
topics.description: Product Hunt topic slugs from the topic URL, e.g. artificial-intelligence, developer-tools. In 'topic' mode: products listed on those topic pages (highest rated first, 15 per page). In 'leaderboard' mode: keep only launches tagged with one of these topics.

keywords.title: Keyword filter
keywords.description: Keep only launches whose name or tagline contains any of these words (case-insensitive). Filtering is local; PH search is not used.

minVotes.title: Minimum votes
minVotes.description: Skip launches with fewer upvotes than this.

startUrls.title: Launch / product URLs
startUrls.description: Used in 'urls' mode. Accepts https://www.producthunt.com/posts/<slug> and /products/<slug> (optionally ?launch=<slug>).

includeDetails.title: Include details (website, makers, rating, categories, description)
includeDetails.description: Opens each launch's product page. Charged as an extra 'launch-details' event.

includeMakers.title: Include public maker names/usernames/headlines
includeMakers.description: Public maker and hunter names, usernames and headlines as shown on the launch page. Never emails or social profiles. Turn off to keep personal data out of your dataset.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only new launches since last run
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: Skips launches already returned by a previous run with the same 'dedupeKey'. Great for daily schedules.

dedupeKey.title: Dedupe key
dedupeKey.description: Name of the persistent store for dedupe state. Use different keys for different schedules.

maxItems.title: Max launches
maxItems.description: Hard cap on dataset rows (and therefore cost). 0 = no cap besides your run's max charge. Each leaderboard page shows the top ~17 launches of that day/week/month.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages are fetched in parallel. Requests are also paced to about 1 per second (slower if Product Hunt pushes back).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed in most cases (plain HTTP works). If Product Hunt starts blocking, the Actor switches to Apify residential proxy automatically (see below).

allowResidentialFallback.title: Allow residential proxy fallback when blocked
allowResidentialFallback.description: If Product Hunt keeps blocking (6 blocked requests in a row, each retried with a fresh session), continue through Apify residential proxy, then return to the direct connection after 25 successful requests. Residential traffic is capped: if it gets expensive, details are paused and listing data continues. Turn off to never use residential proxy.
